description: President Secretariat - Appointment of S. B. Divarathne Esquire, Retired Deputy Secretary to the Treasury and Sumedha Perera Esquire, Retired Major General as the Co-Chairman of the Task Force for Poverty Eradication and Livelihood Development as established by the said Presidential Directive
categorisation: This gazette exclusively contains government personnel changes, specifically the appointment of named individuals (S. B. Divarathne and Sumedha Perera) to the positions of Co-Chairmen of a Task Force. While the Task Force's purpose is mentioned, the document does not assign detailed ministerial portfolios or specific subject matter responsibilities to the individuals. It only provides their basic titles (Co-Chairmen) and names, fitting the criteria for Type 2 (People Gazette).
